title: Linking PageRank, Time Reversal, and Policy Evaluation
summary: We establish a connection between policy evaluation in Markov decision processes and PageRank in network analysis. For a fixed policy, we show that the value function of a discounted Markov decision process can be obtained, up to an explicit rescaling, from the PageRank vector of a suitably defined time-reversed Markov chain. In this correspondence, the discount factor plays the role of the teleportation parameter, while rewards induce the restart distribution.
